GitHub - playcanvas/splat-transform: CLI tool and library for 3D ...
SplatTransform is an open source library and CLI tool for converting and editing Gaussian splats. It can: 📥 Read PLY, Compressed PLY, SOG, Streamed SOG, SPZ, SPLAT, KSPLAT, LCC and LCC2 formats 📤 Write PLY, Compressed PLY, SOG, Streamed SOG, SPZ, GLB, CSV, HTML Viewer, LOD, Voxel and WebP ...
